feedback_patterns.message: Consistently predicting smaller moves than materialize (87.5% of targets undershoot, n=8). Widen price targets — actual moves exceed predictions.

headlines.values_cited: 25 headlines, mostly low-signal Seeking Alpha items; CNBC 'brutal market'; NVDA upgrade 'Crisis Prices Won't Last'; trending: Market Crash Fears, AI Bubble Risks
headlines.influence: Confirms the crowd fear picture but contains little directional information, so the weight is low.

options_flow.values_cited: P/C 2.003, puts $3271.5M vs calls $1633.3M, 16,100 trades; SPXW overnight 86% multileg; AAPL $40.6M deep-ITM calls; NVDA $49.2M deep-ITM puts
options_flow.influence: Mostly index hedging, which lowered my confidence rather than flipping direction. Single-name deep-ITM calls support the AAPL and AMD long ideas.

gex.values_cited: Net GEX -$595M, flip None, put wall 6900, call wall 7000, spot 6924.6
gex.influence: Negative gamma means amplified moves, hence 2x ranges. The walls define the SPY 690 to 700 target anchors.

vix_structure.influence: Raised from earlier weighting per the attribution review (top predictor, underweighted). Backwardation confirms acute fear, a historically contrarian bullish setup, with some risk of further escalation.

vol_regime.values_cited: EXPLOSIVE regime, confidence 44%, 65.5% backtested bullish accuracy, CAG 2.74 BULL-DELUDED, Fear z=+6.35
vol_regime.influence: Primary driver. The bullish-only trend-following rule and the extreme contrarian CAG reading set the direction; the 44% regime confidence caps conviction.

prediction_feedback.values_cited: Overall 52.9% accuracy; LOW tier 75% (n=8); 87.5% target undershoot rate; 30-day accuracy 69.1%
prediction_feedback.influence: Drove target widening and confidence caps. The small sample (n=8) limits the weight.

event_trees.values_cited: No event tree data provided this cycle
event_trees.influence: Zero weight because no event tree inputs were supplied. Only the trending topic 'Geopolitical Instability in the Middle East' is available, and it is not structured.

price_data.influence: Reduced after the attribution review flagged it as overweighted. Quote staleness meant SPX spot was used as the base. High yields are a headwind, but the normal curve (10Y-2Y +0.79%) is not recessionary.

signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX (-$595M) plus VIX backwardation (-6.4%) puts the market in an EXPLOSIVE regime where the backtested bullish-only edge applies (65.5%). CAG at 2.74 with Fear z=+6.35 is a historic contrarian bullish signal. Bearish P/C (2.0) is dominated by SPX/SPXW multileg hedging and so is discounted but still caps conviction. Past undershoot bias (87.5%) drives wider ranges anchored to the 6900/7000 walls (SPY 690/700). Result: BULLISH on all timeframes with confidence of 40/50/60 and no HIGH tier.
